t: To Hell & Back: Hot Gossip from The Inferno II
d: Cast members look back at their time on the show and discuss rivalries, alliances, behind-the-scenes stories and the season's biggest moments.
The 32 competitors arrive in Trinidad and Tobago and learn being team captain comes at a cost, Robin throws Mark a birthday party and one player cracks under pressure.
One player quits the competition, the teams compete in the Chock Full of Coconuts challenge, and two veterans lock horns in the Gauntlet.
Another player withdraws from the competition, securing Kina's spot as rookie team captain, and Aneesa goes off on Cara.
The rookies and veterans try to out-muscle each other in the Moving Pyramid challenge, and one player's erratic behavior makes him a target.
Jodi has a meltdown as Mark and Robin's relationship heats up, things get too close for comfort in the Sponge Worthy challenge, and one player gives the bare minimum during elimination.
The teams strategize to get a leg up in the Body Painters challenge, Alton gives his opponent a fair shot in the Capture the Flag elimination, and Brad and Derrick clash.
Beth and Montana's squabble destroys the veterans' morale at the Rickshaw Races challenge, and Ruthie is bested, giving rise to a new veteran team captain who puts everyone on edge.
Both teams are on high alert after Jillian tells Kina two rookie players formed an alliance with veterans to throw challenges.
Jillian is at odds with Cara and Susie after telling Kina about the alleged alliance, and rivals Beth and Montana square off in the Reverse Tug-of-War elimination.
Jodi comes up with a winning strategy in the Buck-a-Neer challenge, which unexpectedly puts Syrus on the chopping block, and sparks fly between Alton and Jodi.
One team ends their losing streak at the Pull Me challenge, and things get physical when two feuding teammates face off in the Name That Coconut elimination.

t: Tire Me Up, Tire Me Down
d: Alton struggles in the Spare Tires challenge, showing everyone he's only human, and Jeremy tries to dethrone the rookie team captain in the Capture the Flag elimination round.
